analysis.within_network: equal means over the balanced truth, noise, target and random-design repeats
analysis.primary_interval: reference comparisons use protocol-specified 97.5% paired cluster intervals; exploratory only, no confirmatory inference
analysis.other_intervals: pointwise exploratory 95%; no p-values or equivalence claims
analysis.rmse: sqrt(mean network MSE); CI recomputes this transformation for each cluster resample
analysis.relative_mse: mean MSE(first)/mean MSE(second)-1, paired bootstrap ratio; not mean of network ratios
analysis.failure_rates: evaluation-weighted within each network, not counts of independent optimizer calls
analysis.normalization: common independent nonlinear prior-MC response variance; no method-specific denominator
analysis.invalid_scale_policy: do not silently drop: normalized cell is NA if any scale is invalid
analysis.calibration: descriptive whole-network averages, no row-level significance test
analysis.partial_interpretation: No confirmation claim from an incomplete run, even for predeclared contrasts

primary_effects.interpretation: negative favors first method for error metrics
